# Elombe Kisala, Designer & Developer

> Designer and full-stack developer in Jersey City / NYC. Leads web development for Core Home's consumer brands and founded SWFT Studios. Builds websites (Webflow, Cloudflare), Shopify stores, web apps (Cloudflare Workers, D1, Claude API) and native iOS apps (SwiftUI).

## Case studies
- [Built By Me EZ](https://elombekisala.com/work/built-by-me-ez/): A trainer’s brochure site turned into a revenue and operations platform: packages, booking, merch and a CRM, with no traditional server.
- [Snooze Lane](https://elombekisala.com/work/snooze-lane/): A native iOS alarm that wakes commuters before their stop, using geofencing, live NYC/NJ transit data and a phone-call backup.
- [Only at the Kiosk](https://elombekisala.com/work/only-at-the-kiosk/): A magazine, radio station, film archive and shop in one: a dark lifestyle club with a live 3D globe, member accounts and Stripe checkout.
- [Learn Lingala](https://elombekisala.com/work/learn-lingala/): A free, offline-ready app that takes learners from zero to conversational Lingala, with spaced repetition and live chat with Claude-powered speakers.
- [Core Home Finish Library](https://elombekisala.com/work/finish-library/): A 3D configurator that replaced Excel and PowerPoint render specs for Core Home’s product development and design teams.
- [FIZZ](https://elombekisala.com/work/fizz/): A cinematic launch site for a portable sparkling-water bottle: scroll-scrubbed Lottie, 3D z-scroll, Barba page transitions and a matching Shopify theme.
- [SWFT Studios](https://elombekisala.com/work/swft-studios/): The website, client portal, payments and outreach engine for the design and growth studio I founded in Jersey City.
- [People of Spice](https://elombekisala.com/work/people-of-spice/): A spice brand that sells a world of flavor: a spice-and-salt globe intro, a swipeable spice dial and a recipe CMS for 44 blends from 22 kitchens.
- [Roller Reels](https://elombekisala.com/work/roller-reels/): Motorcycle and car videography in NJ and NYC, with a 7-step mobile booking flow, transparent pricing and a $100 deposit.
- [Winslow Pantry](https://elombekisala.com/work/winslow-pantry/): A trilingual brochure site built from the brand guidelines, with WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, generated SEO and a password-protected style guide.
- [Alder Meadow](https://elombekisala.com/work/alder-meadow/): A kitchenware brand site with generated product pages, category filters and a store finder ready for retail partners.
- [Brooklyn Steel Co.](https://elombekisala.com/work/brooklyn-steel-co/): Espresso machines, coffee and accessories. A theme relaunch for the Auto Pour Over, a replacement-parts range and a full help center.
- [Manna Hydration](https://elombekisala.com/work/manna-hydration/): A drinkware store with a cinematic video hero, “find your match” bottle discovery and email capture with a first-order offer.
- [TAL Hydration](https://elombekisala.com/work/tal-hydration/): Water bottles and tumblers for the whole family, with category navigation by use and a retail path to Walmart.
- [Thyme & Table](https://elombekisala.com/work/thyme-and-table/): A dark, premium kitchen and home store spanning prep, cook, serve, drinkware and appliances.
- [corehome.com](https://elombekisala.com/work/core-home/): The parent company’s Webflow site: a 27-brand CMS and a rebuilt AB1200 / PFAS compliance experience with 898 records.
- [Core Home Project Reports](https://elombekisala.com/work/core-home-reports/): A dashboard that turns weekly GitHub activity across every brand repo into plain-language reports for leadership.
- [Blurred Lines Entertainment](https://elombekisala.com/work/blurred-lines/): A premier wedding entertainment brand: bold editorial design, video-led storytelling and a site later migrated to Cloudflare with R2 video hosting.
- [Alpha Ministries International](https://elombekisala.com/work/alpha-ministries-international/): A Webflow site for a Christ-centered ministry: ministries, events, leadership and donation pathways.
